summary: This clinical trial is testing the effects of adding flaxseed to the diet of adults who have type 2 diabetes mellitus that is not well controlled. Researchers are working with 160 participants to see how eating flaxseed changes blood sugar and cholesterol levels over a 12-week period. Universidad Autónoma Benito Juárez de Oaxaca is sponsoring this study.
